basics.name: Qijin Xu
basics.label: Lead AI/ML Architect
basics.summary: Lead AI/ML Architect with {{years+}} years building production AI and the data systems beneath it. Architected an LLM-powered RAG assistant that resolved about 90% of questions on its own for 50,000+ users and returned 525% ROI within 12 months (CGI Impact Award 2024). Now leading a LangGraph agent for a proprietary programming language, projected to cut manual work by 50%. Earlier, built a fraud loss-ratio model with a 321% lift over a top-five bank benchmark.

work.name: CGI Inc.
work.position: Lead AI/ML Architect, AI Center of Excellence
highlights: Lead an AI agent for a proprietary programming language: LangGraph dual-state dynamic workflow, vLLM-served LLMs with RAG, EBNF structured outputs, and PII filtering. It writes documentation, extracts business rules, maintains legacy scripts, and prepares them for migration. Projected 50% less manual work.

work.name: CGI Inc.
work.position: Data Architect & Engineering Lead, Senior Consultant
highlights: CGI Impact Award 2024: architected and shipped an LLM-powered enterprise RAG assistant for insurance support (LangChain; Azure, AWS, GCP). About 90% autonomous resolution for a 50,000+ user base; 525% ROI within 12 months. Product page: [cgi.com/canada/en-ca/insurance-chatbot](https://www.cgi.com/canada/en-ca/insurance-chatbot)
Built an OpenLineage-based lineage tool that auto-documents multi-source data flows, with LLM-assisted root-cause suggestions. Reduced investigation time across about 3 incidents per month.
Automated AxiomSL rule updates at RBC with an LLM: 80% less manual updating, governance controls preserved.

work.name: CGI Inc.
highlights: Managed Canada’s largest automobile-insurance policy-history database (2 TB, SQL Server): 99.9% uptime, median queries under 200 ms.
Built production ETL/ELT pipelines for 22+ micro data marts (under 6 tables each, monthly SLAs) for finance, analytics, and delivery teams. Report runtime cut from 30 to 5 minutes.
Shipped a gradient-boosting and logistic-regression loss-ratio model, batch-scored in a Python/T-SQL pipeline: 321% lift in recovered fraud losses versus a top-five bank benchmark.

work.name: Elder Laboratory, York University
highlights: Worked on AttentiveVision’s computer-vision pipeline for hockey broadcast video (PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV). Trained a CNN-LSTM stack reaching mAP ≥ 70% on event detection across 18 hours of game video.
Built real-time player tracking with a Kalman filter and OpenPose: under 100 ms latency at 30 FPS, for live speed and heat-map analytics.
Built an event-detection annotation loop (goals, timeouts, and penalties) with active learning, raising label reliability to Cohen’s kappa ≥ 0.92.

work.name: Nascent Digital
highlights: Built features in React, TypeScript, and Node.js, including major parts of the company homepage rewrite, and shipped TELUS product pages with UX, QA, and DevOps, design to deploy in 7 days.
Introduced visual-regression testing (Nightwatch.js, Puppeteer), removing about 90% of manual QA checks.
